acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params.initialOwner: Two-step owner (represents future governance; fictional/local here).
params.recoveryRecipient_: Immutable destination for post-deadline recoveries. Nonzero.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

publishCycle(uint256,bytes32,bytes32,byt.details: fundedAmounts are the TASK 3 `allocated` participant entitlements only — never the      strategic reserve, distribution dust, full participant pool, or other inventory. Each      asset is pulled from msg.sender via SafeERC20 and the received balance delta must equal      the declared amount exactly (fee-on-transfer / short transfers revert the whole call).

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

assetFunding(uint256,address).notice: Per-cycle, per-asset funding and consumption accounting.

claim(uint256,address,uint256,bytes32[]).notice: Claim a single entitlement for msg.sender.

claimBatch(uint256,(address,uint256,byte.notice: Claim multiple entitlements for msg.sender within one cycle, atomically.

claimed(uint256,address,address).notice: Whether a given (cycle, claimant, asset) entitlement has been consumed.

cycles(uint256).notice: Published cycles by id. Immutable once `published` is true.

leafFor(uint256,address,address,uint256).notice: The Merkle leaf for an entitlement, bound to this chain and this manager.

publishCycle(uint256,bytes32,bytes32,byt.notice: Publish and fully fund an immutable cycle in a single atomic transaction.

recoverExpired(uint256,address).notice: After a cycle's deadline, sweep the remaining unclaimed balance of one cycle asset         to the immutable recovery recipient. Callable by anyone; the caller cannot choose         the destination or the amount (both derive from recorded accounting).

recoveryRecipient().notice: Immutable destination for all post-deadline recoveries. Set once at construction.

remaining(uint256,address).notice: Remaining unclaimed, unrecovered liability for a cycle asset.

totalOutstanding(address).notice: Total outstanding participant liability per token across every cycle.
